originality.rationale: The exact all-odd-prime, all-suffix index–value closure with carry-ideal fibers is not a formal corollary of the already published unrestricted scalar density theorem; the proof adds uniform p-adic unit-block generation plus a prescribed-suffix carry construction. residual_risks: The 1998 proof contains reusable techniques and a straightforward unindexed sharpening could have been noted elsewhere; formal priority is not certified.
The 2001 Barat–Grabner source was not available in full text for direct comparison; the abstract alone cannot establish noncoverage.
The 2002 Cai–Granville full text was not accessible through the attempted authorized route; abstract summaries are insufficient to exclude every equivalence.
A complete literature or independent mathematical audit has not been performed.

value.rationale: The theorem completely determines a natural joint p-adic index–value graph from Kummer carries: each index cylinder has one exact ideal as its image, and limiting fibers can be proper ideals or {0}. A prior unrestricted value-coordinate density theorem cannot identify these index-dependent fibers; this addresses a genuinely structural question without relying on unmotivated special parameters.
